summary: Iteration 25 — Abilities framework fully verified. Backend catalog + toggle/permission-gate + tool-gating + twin SSE gating all pass (8/8 pytest). Frontend /abilities page renders, 6 ability cards grouped by category, permission dialog + toggle-on/off flow works. Restored fork23 to defaults post-test.
critical_code_review_comments: abilities.py + routers/abilities.py are clean, single-purpose modules (~215 + 63 lines). Permission validation is strict (subset check). Defaults sensible (terminal opt-in).

twin.py correctly gates music short-circuit on 'music' ability, smart-home auto-skill on 'smart_home', and filters TOOL_SCHEMAS via enabled_tool_names. Core memory tools always injected — good separation.
Frontend Abilities.jsx uses data-testid pervasively (root/card/toggle/dialog/confirm). Permission dialog only opens for OFF→ON; disable is one-click. Good UX.

Minor: teardown_module in the pytest file is best-effort and requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var to be set when invoking pytest (I passed it explicitly). Consider a conftest fixture that reads from /app/frontend/.env for future-proofing.
seed_data_creation: None. Test operates on fork23 user_abilities collection and restores defaults on teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The pytest requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to be exported (it's read from env, no default). Run: `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) && cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iteration25_abilities.py -q`. fork23 abilities are restored to defaults (web/music/smart_home/pc_control/screen_vision enabled, terminal off).
